components.name: Vote Keeper
components.description: Tallies signed votes per round, detects quorum thresholds, emits at-most-once threshold events, and records equivocation evidence.
headlineProperties: Each threshold output is emitted at most once per (round, vote-type, value)
PolkaValue(v) implies strictly more than 2/3 weight of validators prevoted v in that round
SkipRound(r) implies strictly more than 1/3 weight of validators cast any vote for round r
An equivocating vote never produces a threshold output (absorbed into evidence)
components.specHints: apply_vote at core-votekeeper/src/keeper.rs:249 is the single entry point returning Option<Output>; model as pure (Bookkeeper, Vote, Round) -> (Bookkeeper, Output). emitted_outputs: BTreeSet enforces idempotency (mirror as emittedOutputs: Set). skip_round check at keeper.rs:292 uses the honest f+1 threshold, not quorum. Existing spec: specs/consensus/quint/votekeeper.qnt (Bookkeeper mirrors VoteKeeper, RoundVotes mirrors PerRound); already replayed by the MBT oracle (quint-oracle.json).

components.name: Round State Machine
components.description: Per-round Tendermint state machine (Unstarted -> Propose -> Prevote -> Precommit -> Commit); pure transition from typed Input to Transition.
headlineProperties: Agreement: once decision is set to value v, it is never changed to a different value
Validity: decision only reaches Commit via the ProposalAndPrecommitValue input
Lock safety: locked is only set forward, never to a value contradicting a prior precommit
No output is produced from Step::Commit
components.specHints: state_machine.rs:71 apply() is the single transition function with a full match table at :82 (each arm maps to a spec line L11-L67). State<Ctx> at state.rs:99 holds step, locked, valid, decision, scheduled_timeouts. is_valid_pol_round guard at state_machine.rs:56 must be in spec. ScheduledTimeouts bitmask enforces timeout-scheduling idempotency. Existing spec: specs/consensus/quint/consensus.qnt (ConsensusState / consensus() maps to apply()); already replayed by consensus MBT runner.

components.name: Driver
components.description: Integrates the round state machine with the vote keeper and proposal keeper; multiplexes proposals and threshold events into round inputs and stores certificates.
headlineProperties: A vote is output at most once per (height, round, vote-type) for a given node
No precommit for value v is emitted unless round_state.valid is consistent with v
A pending input queued by a step change is always processed before the next external input
components.specHints: driver.rs:358 process()/apply() is the top-level entry; apply_vote at :542 is the vote path; lift_vote_output at :402 carries the vote-dedup guard. The multiplexer table in mux.rs:17-28 (multiplex_proposal at :81) maps (step x VKOutput x proposalPresent) -> RoundInput. pending_inputs loop at driver.rs:370 cascades transitions within one process() call. Existing spec: specs/consensus/quint/driver.qnt (DriverState) but NO MBT/ITF replay wired yet.

components.name: Consensus Orchestrator
components.description: Top-level effect-yielding coroutine routing all external inputs to the driver, emitting effects (timeouts, publish, WAL, decide) and managing the finalization period.
headlineProperties: finalization_period is entered exactly once per height and exited exactly once
Inputs for past heights are dropped; inputs for future heights are buffered at most one height ahead
A SyncDecision requires a commit certificate already stored in the driver
WAL replay is deterministic: replaying WAL entries produces the same published-vote set as the pre-crash run
components.specHints: handle.rs:27 handle()/handle_input() at :40 is the entry. State<Ctx> at state.rs:15 embeds driver + full_proposal_keeper + input_queue + finalization_period. Effect enum at effect.rs:48, Input at input.rs:12. full_proposal_keeper mediates the proposal-vs-value race (Entry states ProposalOnly|ValueOnly|Full). finalization_period is a 2-phase-commit latch (decide.rs:7 sets, finalize.rs:3 clears). handle/sync.rs:23 maybe_sync_decision is a shortcut decision path bypassing voting. Only partially covered by statemachineAsync.qnt; no dedicated orchestrator spec.

components.name: Value Sync
components.description: Client/server protocol letting lagging nodes request and receive decided values and commit certificates from peers.
headlineProperties: validRequestInvariant: a request is only sent to a peer whose advertised tip covers the requested height
noOldRequestsInv: no open request for a height below the client's current height
serverRespondsToRequestingPeersInvariant: a server only responds to clients that have (or had) an open request
Every open request eventually terminates (liveness)
components.specHints: handle.rs:57 handle() has 9 input variants; State<Ctx> at state.rs:22 holds consensus_height, tip_height, sync_height, pending_requests, peers, peer_scorer. Invariant sync_height > tip_height (state.rs:42); the sync_height rewind on concurrent re-request is the subject of recent fix 5cd137fb. Rich existing spec suite in specs/synchronization/valuesync/quint/ (valuesync, valuesyncClient, valuesyncServer, vsyncStatemachine, vsyncWithConsensus, vsyncWithMockedConsensus) but NO MBT/ITF harness yet. Client and server split cleanly into standalone specs.

components.name: Equivocation Detection
components.description: Detects and records double-vote and double-proposal evidence, surfaced via take_vote_evidence / take_proposal_evidence.
headlineProperties: An equivocating vote never triggers a threshold output (safety)
Evidence is accumulated, never dropped until take_evidence() is called
Evidence contains exactly two conflicting votes from the same validator for the same (height, round, vote-type)
components.specHints: EvidenceMap at core-votekeeper/src/evidence.rs:1 (DoubleVote type); equivocation branch in apply_vote at keeper.rs:270-281. Separate proposal EvidenceMap in core-driver/src/proposal_keeper.rs. A distinct accountability model exists at specs/consensus/accountable-tm/misbehavior.qnt + accTypes.qnt, not wired to the MBT harness. Property spans vote-keeper + driver + orchestrator, so it does not ground fully on any single one.

components.name: Write-Ahead Log
components.description: Append-only, CRC-checked log persisting votes, proposals and certificates before broadcast, enabling crash-recovery replay.
headlineProperties: Every entry read back has a matching CRC (integrity)
A truncated/corrupted suffix is detected and does not poison earlier valid entries
Replay of all valid entries produces exactly the pre-crash state (determinism)
components.specHints: Log/LogEntry on-disk format (flag|length|CRC|data) in wal/src/log.rs; concrete Log<File> in wal/src/file.rs. WalEntry is one of {Vote, Proposal, PolkaCertificate, RoundCertificate}. Model as a sequence of typed entries with a last-valid cursor; the corruption scenario (partial write + restart) is the interesting behavioral case. Key ordering invariant vs core-consensus: WAL is written before the corresponding vote/proposal is published. No Quint spec exists yet.

components.name: Proposal Streaming
components.description: Reassembles a streamed multi-part proposal (INIT / DATA* / FIN) into a complete value, buffering out-of-order delivery.
headlineProperties: Messages are emitted in sequence order despite out-of-order receipt
FIN terminates the stream; no messages emitted after FIN
Each sequence number is emitted at most once
components.specHints: Rust part storage in code/crates/app/src/part_store.rs. Existing Quint model specs/block-streaming/part_stream.qnt with State = {buffer: BinaryHeap, initMessage, nextSequence, totalMessages, finReceived, emitted} plus supporting specs/block-streaming/binary_heap.qnt. Spec exists but no Rust MBT harness wired.
